newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PCI Bank board approves real estate jv.
newsitem.headline: PCI Bank board approves real estate jv.

text.p: The Philippine Commercial International Bank said on Tuesday its board of directors approved the bank's entry into a joint venture agreement with real estate developer Jaka Tagaytay Development Corp.
In an advisory to the Philippine Stock Exchange, PCI Bank said the agreement will make the bank one of the investors in a joint venture company named Tagaytay Land Inc.

Last April, PCI Bank, Metropolitan Bank and Trust Co (Metrobank) and SolidBank Corp signed an initial agreement with Jaka Tagaytay Development Corp to develop a property in the Batangas town of Laurel, south of Manila, into a residential complex with commercial and recreational facilities.
